title: Autoscore Attestation Quotas & Granular Pricing-Credit Pilot
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Run a pilot that automatically estimates customer effort for SIG/CAIQ-style security questionnaires and issues fine-grained pricing credits (attestation_credits). Replace coarse manual credit buckets with an auditable autoscore + human-review fallback to speed contract closes and reduce SE/solutions workload.
acceptance_criteria: Autoscore engine produces a numeric 'attestation_score' and recommended credit amount for submitted questionnaire bundles
UI surfaces recommended credit, justification summary, and a single-click 'approve/adjust' flow for SEs
API exposes attestation_credits and attestation_score fields in enterprise contract responses (v1) and is backward compatible
Pilot launched with 10 beta customers and internal SE team for 4 weeks with telemetry enabled
Measurement dashboards show decision latency, human override rate, and delta to historical manual credits
success_metrics: Reduce median SE review time per questionnaire from 48h to <12h
Human override rate <= 25% after two-week calibration
Average time to grant credit drops to <1 business day for pilot cohort
Pilot NPS for SE experience > 7.5 (out of 10) on internal survey
No critical security incidents attributable to automated scoring during pilot
proposed_solution: Build an Autoscore service that ingests CAIQ/SIG export bundles and applies a deterministic rubric + lightweight ML model to estimate reviewer-hours. Map estimated hours to a tiered credit formula (pro-rated monthly credit). Surface results in Console (Enterprise > Contracts > Attestations) and in the Contract API. Provide a human override workflow and an appeal path for customers.
technical_notes: Autoscore composition: rule-based counts (question count, 'high' answers), heuristics (third-party vendor mentions), and an LLM-assisted summarizer to extract unique evidence asks
Model: small classification/estimation model (XGBoost or linear reg) trained on historical tickets and annotated hours
API changes: POST /enterprise/attestations/score -> returns { attestation_score, estimated_hours, recommended_credits_usd, summary_html }
Security: scoring service runs in Private region for customer data; results logged with redaction; KMS-protected export for evidence used in appeals
Instrumentation: New Grafana dashboard (attestation.autoscore.*), SLOs for scoring latency (<3s per bundle), and recorder for override reasons
PRs: backend prototype branch (github.com/redwood-inference/attestation-autoscore/tree/feature/prototype), console UI draft PR pending
ux_notes: Design will show a compact card with score, top 3 driver reasons, recommended credit, and two actions: Approve (single click) or Request More Info. Desktop-first; mobile condensed view. Must include 'why this amount' expandable transcript for audits.
